about: Zameer Sports Dinga is a complete sports centre and cricket specialist shop in Dinga (Kharian Tehsil, Gujrat District, Punjab, Pakistan), located on Kolian Road in Aslah Market at Board Chowk. They stock cricket bats (incl. their own 'Zameer Legend' Grade-1 English-willow coconut bat and the 2026 Zameer Legend edition), tape-ball gear, cricket/brand sports shoes, volleyball (Jagga Gold/Star/AAA at wholesale), Yonex badminton rackets, shuttlecocks (Victor, U-Max, VSV qualities), sports kits and club equipment, and they provide trophies for tournaments. They offer free delivery across Pakistan on bat orders, cash-on-delivery payment, wholesale pricing and guarantees. The shop is deeply embedded in the local sports community: it sponsors village volleyball clubs and tournaments (Mian Volleyball Club Chak Jani, Mandeer Club Kharian, Shahin Volleyball Club Kirnana, Falcon Club Amra Kalan), runs the 'Zameer Sports Legends Cricket League' (now in Season 5 with Champion Trophy 2026), and even ships brand kits to customers in the UK. Instagram bio: 'ZAMEER SPORTS — Daily Sports Content, Passion Cricket Entertainment, Follow And Join Sports family.'
